subject: Re: Error with running CFA using ordinal variables

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: Error with running CFA using ordinal variables
parts:
Should it be a colon, rather than a hyphen?


Not: fit=cfa(MODEL, ordered=paste0("V_", 1-101), data=DATA2)

But: fit=cfa(MODEL, ordered=paste0("V_", 1:101), data=DATA2)

Jeremy


On Thu, 5 May 2016 at 13:51 <zrc2...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello,

In running a CFA with ordinal variables (all variables are ordinal with 4 levels of responses), I received the following error: 
In lav_partable_check(lavpartable, categorical = categorical, warn = TRUE) :
  lavaan WARNING: parameter table does not contain thresholds 


Code used:fit=cfa(MODEL, ordered=paste0("V_", 1-101), data=DATA2)

The model worked just fine when I did not include the "ordered" setting and simply treated the variables as continuous. 

Thank you in advance for your time and consideration.

--
